tool_args.rationale: The slow-horizon probe established a positive response at H=8.47 and negative responses at H=17.42 and 24.2. Fit the recalled dual-horizon law numerically across all eight observations and test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed rows have zero s_grad and show a reversal consistent with the simpler dual-exponential mechanism; the sink parameter is not identifiable from these observations.
The short-window gain followed by a slow reversal is consistent with adaptation; the recalled harmonic model does not explain the observed short-horizon shape as directly.
The acquired slow-horizon observations already cover the reversal and target horizon, so confirmation of the four-parameter model is the next informative step.
